# supermemory

> supermemory is a memory API for AI agents and apps: it extracts memories from conversations, documents and files, keeps a profile for each user, and returns the right context through search. This repository holds the docs, the MCP server, the web app and agent skills.

The current API is v5. Every call is scoped to a namespace (a user, a tenant or a project):

- Add content: POST https://api.supermemory.ai/ns/{namespace}/document
- Search memories and documents: POST https://api.supermemory.ai/ns/{namespace}/search
- Read the profile: POST https://api.supermemory.ai/ns/{namespace}/profile

SDKs (version 5 or later): `npm install supermemory` or `pip install supermemory`. The namespace is the first argument: `client.add(namespace, { content })`, `client.search(namespace, { query })`, `client.profile(namespace)`.

Do not use `containerTag`, `containerTags`, `/v3` or `/v4` in new code. Those API versions shut down on December 31, 2026.

- [Self-hosting](https://supermemory.ai/docs/self-hosting/overview.md)

## In this repository

- `apps/docs`: the documentation source (Mintlify)
- `apps/mcp`: the Supermemory MCP server
- `skills/supermemory`: the agent skill for building with Supermemory
